record_audits.database_comments: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (86.96%) to CZS-2 V: 17%, L:13%. GRAVY: 0.717; mol Wt: 2446.873; mol formula: C112H185N29O31; mol ex coeff: 0. Activity: Active against E. coli (MIC 13.09 uM), S. aureus (MIC 26.18 uM), and C. albicans (MIC 52.36 uM). Parasites: T. cruzi Trypomastigotes (IC50 1.55 uM) or Amastigotes (IC50 30.65 uM), P. falciparum NF54 (IC50 13.86 uM) or TM90C2B (IC50 4.87 uM), L. Mexicana (IC50 0.09 uM). In vitro toxicity: 4% RBC: hemolysis of 13% at 128 uM (HC50>100 uM), low hemo.lytic.
